key.name: auto-detect-location
key.summary: Automatically detect location and calculate sunrise/sunset times.

key.name: use-manual-coordinates
key.summary: Use manually entered coordinates instead of custom times.

key.name: manual-latitude
key.summary: Manual latitude for sunrise/sunset calculation.

key.name: manual-longitude
key.summary: Manual longitude for sunrise/sunset calculation.

key.name: control-brightness
key.summary: Control screen brightness gradually throughout the day.

key.name: light-brightness
key.summary: Screen brightness percentage for light mode (0-100).

key.name: dark-brightness
key.summary: Screen brightness percentage for dark mode (0-100).

key.name: last-brightness-update
key.summary: Timestamp (in milliseconds) of the last brightness update.

key.name: last-session-id
key.summary: Session ID from last enable() call to distinguish login from unlock.

key.name: gradual-brightness-decrease-enabled
key.summary: Enable gradual brightness decrease before dark mode.

key.name: gradual-brightness-decrease-duration
key.summary: Duration in seconds to gradually decrease brightness before dark mode trigger (default: 2 hours).

key.name: gradual-brightness-increase-enabled
key.summary: Enable gradual brightness increase before light mode.

key.name: gradual-brightness-increase-duration
key.summary: Duration in seconds to gradually increase brightness before light mode trigger (default: 2 hours).

key.name: light-theme
key.summary: The GTK theme to use during the day.

key.name: dark-theme
key.summary: The GTK theme to use at night.

key.name: true-light-mode
key.summary: Enable True Light Mode - makes the top bar/shell light in addition to GTK apps.
key.description: When enabled, switches the system color-scheme preference to make the GNOME Shell top bar light. When disabled, only GTK themes are switched while keeping the shell/top bar dark. Note: This option only affects systems using stock GNOME (like Fedora). Ubuntu keeps the top bar dark by default regardless of this setting.

key.name: night-light-mode
key.summary: Night Light control mode ('disabled', 'sync-with-theme', or 'custom-schedule').

key.name: night-light-start-time
key.summary: Time to enable Night Light (HH:MM) when using custom schedule.

key.name: night-light-end-time
key.summary: Time to disable Night Light (HH:MM) when using custom schedule.

key.name: show-notifications
key.summary: Show notifications when the theme is switched automatically.

key.name: light-mode-trigger
key.summary: What time to use for switching to light mode ('first-light', 'dawn', 'sunrise', 'solar-noon', or 'custom').

key.name: dark-mode-trigger
key.summary: What time to use for switching to dark mode ('solar-noon', 'golden-hour', 'sunset', 'dusk', 'last-light', or 'custom').

key.name: custom-light-time
key.summary: The custom time (HH:MM) to switch to light mode if light-mode-trigger is 'custom'.

key.name: custom-dark-time
key.summary: The custom time (HH:MM) to switch to dark mode if dark-mode-trigger is 'custom'.
